Messages.Author: Kristyl Meth
Messages.Body:
Question:

I control Anson and a Parthenon, giving me three master phase actions every
turn. If I call a Rumors of Gehenna vote and name myself as one of the
recipients, how many master phase actions do I now have? Four or two or
something else?

Messages.Author: Richard Zopf
Messages.Body:
Kristyl Meth wrote in message
<01be965a$4161bce0$81a5...@dapatrin.riderlaw.com>...

Anson and Rumors do not stack. You get two master phase actions, no matter
if you use either or both. Parthenon adds on top (as it says an additional
MPA), and thus you may have a max of 3 Master Phase Actions

Regards,
R. David Zopf
Atom Weaver (& V:EKN Prince of Charlotte, NC)

Not quite. You have two every turn and can tap the Parthenon for an extra.

Messages.Body:

<dapa...@riderlaw.com> wrote:

>Question:
>
>I control Anson and a Parthenon, giving me three master phase actions every
>turn. If I call a Rumors of Gehenna vote and name myself as one of the

>recipients, how many master phase actions do I now have? Four or two or

3 - Anson gives you 2 - Partheon gives you +1- Rumors gives you 2 not
+1 so Anson and rumors are the same thing.
